name: ZCA_ORCH_RT_ERROR_LOGS
description: Contains the list of errors that could occur when processing the Orchestration process with respect to the transactional object.

columns.name: ERROR_LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration error logs.

columns.name: ERROR_LOG_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier or alternate key of the Orchestration error log.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Language independent code of the transactional object. For example, Lead, Opportunity, etc.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the source object.

columns.name: ERROR_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Specifies the description of the error.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestrations object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_STAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration stages object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_STEP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration steps object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ASSOC_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration association.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).
